en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: I said to Abu Abdullah (as): "My father has performed Hajj, my mother has performed Hajj, and my two brothers have also performed Hajj. I wish to include them in my Hajj, as I would love for them to be with me."
Imam (as) said: "Include them with you. Allah (swt), the Exalted, will grant them the reward of Hajj, and you will also have your Hajj, along with a reward for maintaining ties with them."
